records.notes: Primary: DS20PG/1118 (2018) data sheet + BIL/0622 (2022) brochure; manufacturer product page (solarturbines.com) not openable (Akamai 403 to curl, DNS refused for WebFetch), so newest openable manufacturer PDFs used. eff_pct 24.3 is PUBLISHED ('Engine efficiency: 24.3% (measured at generator terminals)'); 3600/14795 = 24.33 agrees. exh_flow_kg_s = 23 540 kg/hr / 3600 (unit conversion); Turbomach 2012 handbook publishes 6.54 kg/s directly. Inconsistency as published: inlet airflow 5.8 kg/s vs exhaust flow 6.54 kg/s (fuel ~0.1 kg/s cannot explain 0.74 kg/s) - check with Solar before sizing ducts. out_rpm: only MAX turbine speed 22,300 rpm is published; nominal gearbox-input speed not stated. Package weight editions: DS20PG/1118 (2018) 10 205 kg (22,500 lb) dry, enclosed height - TAKEN; BIL/0622 (2022) and BPGPSG/116 (2016) also 10 205 kg, 6.7x2.4x2.7 m; older editions give 'Typical Weight: 10 530 kg (23,215 lb)' with the same 6.7x2.4x2.7 m: DS20GS/1109 (2009, O&G sheet, https://s7d2.scene7.com/is/content/Caterpillar/C10550203) and DS20PG/0113 (2013, https://s7d2.scene7.com/is/content/Caterpillar/C10550179) - both opened 14.11.2026; BO&G/811 (2011) gives 5.8x1.7x2.0 m, 9980 kg (approximate, unenclosed); Turbomach 2012 handbook gives L 6.0, W 1.8, H 7.6 m, 14 t (H and weight incl. filter system, outdoor). Length published as 6.7 m (21'11") on DS20PG drawing and 6.7 m (22'0") in BIL/0622. inlet_dp/exhaust_dp = 0: this is the rating basis ('No inlet/exhaust losses'), not a package duct loss. Turbomach 2012 handbook (Solar-group packager) gives 1.20 MW, 14 810 kJ/kWh, 24.32%, 506 C - older edition, not taken.

extra.speed_conflict: UNRESOLVED. DS20MD/1109 (C10550212) and DS20CS/1109 (https://s7d2.scene7.com/is/content/Caterpillar/C10550141), both 2009 sheets of one template, print Gas Producer 'Max. Speed: 15,000 rpm' and Power Turbine 'Max. Speed: 22,300 rpm'. The single-shaft GS sheets (DS20GS/1109, DS20PG/1118) run the same 8-stage, 6.7:1 compressor at 22,300 rpm; a compressor at 15,000 rpm could not reach 6.7:1 with more airflow (MD 6.4 vs GS 5.8 kg/s), so a GP/PT transposition (GP 22,300 / PT 15,000) is possible. No independent source opened; values kept as published, confirm with Solar (TPS20CSMD) before sizing coupling or gearbox.

records.notes: Performance confirmed in the newest openable manufacturer sheet DS20CS/0624 (2024) and in DS20MD/1109 (2009), BIL/0622 (2022), BO&G/0819 (2019), BO&G/811 (2011): 1185 kW (1590 hp), 14 670 kJ/kW-hr, 23 410 kg/hr, 520 C. Manufacturer product page not openable (Akamai 403 / DNS). eff_pct 24.5 is PUBLISHED ('Engine efficiency: 24.5%' in DS20MD/1109 and DS20CS/0624); BIL/0622 table shows 24.6; 3600/14670 = 24.54. exh_flow_kg_s = 23 410 kg/hr / 3600 = 6.50 (unit conversion). Inlet airflow published 6.4 kg/s. Speeds as published in DS20MD/1109: Gas Producer Turbine 'Max. Speed: 15,000 rpm', Power Turbine 'Max. Speed: 22,300 rpm' (checked visually on the PDF). Note the single-shaft GS sheet gives the same 8-stage compressor/3-stage turbine a max speed of 22,300 rpm, so the GP 15,000 / PT 22,300 assignment should be confirmed with Solar before designing the coupling or gearbox - possible transposition, NOT corrected here. PT nominal speed and operating range are not published in any opened document ('Optimum power turbine speed' is the rating basis only). Package editions: DS20MD/1109 driver package 4.7x1.9x2.0 m, typical 6805 kg (15,000 lb) - TAKEN, same in BIL/0622 (2022) CS/MD table; BO&G/811 (2011) 'approximate dimensions (unenclosed)' mechanical drive 4.0x1.8x2.2 m, 4540 kg (10,000 lb); DS20CS/0624 (2024) compressor set (turbine + gas compressor) 6.8x1.6x2.3 m, approx 7550 kg 'dry weight, unenclosed height, does not include ancillary equipment' (lb value printed as 61,640 - misprint). inlet_dp/exhaust_dp = 0: rating basis ('No inlet/exhaust losses'), not a package duct loss. Package-spec items (fuel gas supply pressure, starter power, lube tank) exist in the Saturn 20 CS/MD Turbomachinery Package Specification, which is not on manualsdir.com and whose copies are on hosts outside the allowed list; a search-engine snippet quoting 'Minimum/Maximum Gas Fuel Supply Pressure 897 to 1241 kPag (130 to 180 psig)' was NOT opened and is not entered.
